source.attribution: User-supplied summary attributed to Frank Ochoa; full-book coverage and exact wording not verified

corrections: Normalize CPR bounds with min/max of raw BC and TC; raw TC may be below raw BC.
Outside reversals require indexed bars; literal Low < Low and High > High cannot be executable definitions.
Time-based POC and volume-based POC are distinct; VPOC is also used ambiguously for virgin versus volume POC.
A virgin profile level is untested in subsequent sessions, not untouched in its formation session.
Reported touch rates do not establish trade win rates or monthly income probability.
Narrow/wide CPR thresholds, average-range lookbacks, equality tolerances and tie policies require explicit specifications.
Current-period and future daily bars cannot supply prior completed higher-timeframe pivots.
OHLCV-uniform volume profiles are modeled approximations, not observed executed volume by price.
